name: cudafast-qwen38-125b-a6b
description: Qwen 3.8 125B A6B CUDA text-tower inference speedup track (unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF, variant UD-Q4_K_XL, a GGUF conversion of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next @ f5d08274bafd880402bd16f5e3e6c514136ec06c). The tower is 48 layers on a four-layer repeat: the last layer of each group (index % 4 == 3, i.e. 3/7/.../47) is full attention and the other three are gated deltanet linear attention, so 12 layers carry a KV cache and 36 carry a constant-size recurrent state. Full attention is 24 query heads over 2 KV heads at head_dim 256, partial rotary 0.25, interleaved mrope, with a QSA indexer (4 heads, 1 KV head, dim 128, budget 2048, compress 4). Every layer carries a sparse MoE block of 512 routed experts, 10 per token, moe_intermediate 640, plus a shared expert of the same width behind a shared expert gate. Hyper-connections run at width 4, lowrank 320. Layer 1 carries the n-gram / PLE table, which the artifact quantizes in place at IQ4_NL. Embeddings are untied. The engine is the ds4 port (Layr-Labs/ds4, our fork of antirez/ds4), VENDORED at ds4/ (plain files, not a submodule, so a participant can read, edit and submit it; ds4/VENDOR.json records the signed base) and built by tools/ds4/build.sh; the scored binary is the Engine Protocol v1 adapter (harness/protocol-adapter) with the ds4 engine linked in-process. The port carries the qwen4exp model family the target needs: the multi-shard GGUF loader, the qwen4exp kernels and graph, the nextn MTP head behind --mtp-model and the speculative cycle at depths 1 to 6. There is exactly ONE speculative arm: the NATIVE MTP head, a pinned Q8_0 GGUF that sits in the organizer-staged target snapshot beside the shards. No submission carries a head weight: mtp-head.manifest.json is a DECLARATION only, it stays editable and optional, and it accepts source 'pinned' only. There is NO DFlash arm on this track. Draft depth is participant-selectable: permitted depths are 1 to 6. Depth 1 is one MTP draft per target-verified cycle, and the pinned engine implements all six, so every permitted depth runs. The depth that actually ran is sealed per run as effective_spec, alongside the realized draft length effective_mean_draft_len. The target model may never be re-quantized. The KV backend is pinned contiguous and refuses rather than degrades. Scoring is SINGLE-STREAM and PAIRED: a serial-control leg on the reference tree at fixtures/qwen3_8_125b_a6b_track.json baseline_reference_commit runs on the same box, in the same job, beside the candidate leg, and composite = prefill_gain^0.25 * decode_gain^0.75 (David rulings 2026-08-27, 2026-09-08). No baseline pair is stored in a constant, in the fixture or in a golden. fixtures/qwen3_8_125b_a6b_track.json scoring_semantics is the authority. The participant-editable surface is the VENDORED ENGINE (ds4), the engine adapter (harness) and the MTP head declaration (mtp-head, mtp-head.manifest.json); editablePaths is the authority. docs/participant-contract.md section 5 is the authority for the scoring rules.
